title: UTIITSL PAN Application Fees Structure
section: Note: PAN application fees are all at Government prescribed rates fixed by the Income Tax Department of India. Page 1 of 2  --- Page 2 --- PAN Application Fees at UTIITSL (w.e.f. 16th June 2018) Option 2: The Applicant requires only an e-PAN Card, and no physical PAN Card. An Applicant while submitting his/her PAN application form has to select the “e-PAN Card only, No physical PAN Card” option on the form if the physical PAN Card is not required. Here e-mail id is mandatory and this option is applicable only if a valid/active e-mail id is mentioned by the applicant on the form. By selecting “e-PAN Card only, No physical PAN Card” option on the PAN application form, the applicant gets: · No physical PAN Card. · Only an e-PAN Card in PDF format, that shall be mailed to the e-mail id mentioned by the applicant in the application form, only if it has been provided and is valid/active. A) If the applicant submits the PAN application physically at the PAN Centres of UTIITSL : PAN Application Fees Sr. No. Dispatch particulars ( in Rs., inclusive of the applicable tax GST@18% ) For sending of e-PAN Card pdf to the e-mail id mentioned by 1. 72.00 the applicant in the PAN application form B) If the applicant applies online on the website of UTIITSL but submits the PAN application through physical mode i.e. forwards the physical documents to the PAN Centres of UTIITSL : PAN Application Fees Sr. No. Dispatch particulars ( in Rs., inclusive of the applicable tax GST@18% ) For sending of e-PAN Card pdf to the e-mail id mentioned by 1. 72.00 the applicant in the PAN application form C) If the applicant applies online on the website of UTIITSL and submits the PAN application through paperless mode on the website itself i.e. using Aadhaar based e-KYC with e-Sign OR using scanned/digilocker docs with e-Sign OR using scanned/digilocker docs with Digital Signature Certificate : PAN Application Fees Sr. No. Dispatch particulars ( in Rs., inclusive of the applicable tax GST@18% ) For sending of e-PAN Card pdf to the e-mail id mentioned by 1. 66.00 the applicant in the PAN application form ********************************************************************************************************* Note: PAN application fees are all at Government prescribed rates fixed by the Income Tax Department of India.
